question: Should the member-owned QA Lab change that holds partition scheduler resources across one infrastructure retry be accepted after a current-main rebase and targeted partition replay verification?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes operational retry semantics at the shared suite-launch boundary, and the protected maintainer label plus current-main drift require an explicit owner decision before merge.

options.title: Rebase and accept the partition boundary
options.body: Refresh the branch on current main, confirm the focused partition-count and retry-exhaustion tests still cover every launcher entry point, then merge.

options.title: Adjust the resource contract first
options.body: Pause for a narrower scheduler change if QA Lab owners determine that exclusive keys or weights must be released between attempts.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept the partition boundary
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch on current main, confirm the focused partition-count and retry-exhaustion tests still cover every launcher entry point, then merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current reproducible report and proposed boundary change, and are the visible member contact for this QA Lab behavior.
